store_info.description_short: Virtual collaborative whiteboard for sketching hand-drawn-style diagrams.
description_long: Excalidraw is an open-source virtual whiteboard for sketching hand-drawn-style diagrams, wireframes and sketches. It is fast, has an infinite canvas, and needs no account.

This is the fully self-hosted stack: the Excalidraw editor, a real-time collaboration server, and a storage backend that persists shared boards on your shard. Invite others to a live board with a link and draw together in real time.
Boards are shared by link only, with no sign-up. Drawing data for collaboration links is end-to-end encrypted, so the link itself is the key to a board.
hint: Boards are reached by link. Anyone with a board link can open and collaborate on it, and a lost link cannot be recovered by an administrator, so keep collaboration links safe.
